top_signals.title: Chip Rout Sinks Emerging-Market Stocks; Currencies Trade Mixed
top_signals.summary: A selloff in semiconductor stocks pressured Asian bourses and pushed the emerging-market benchmark to the lowest in more than three months, while currencies were mixed on the eve of the Federal Reserve’s decision.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
